user_query: I'm hosting a chess workshop for kids in my neighborhood. Can you provide me with a variety of chess puzzles suitable for different age groups? Also, recommend a random champion from League of Legends to make the workshop more engaging for the kids.

TaskList.description: Gather a collection of chess puzzles categorized by age group and difficulty level.
Retrieve a random champion name and a brief description from League of Legends to present to the kids.
